proposed.explanation: Group 1 covers buildings of simplest utilization and character — utilitarian structures like warehouses and simple factories, not residentials. Group 3 covers buildings of exceptional character housing special equipment — churches, theaters, museums — not standard residential buildings. Group 7 covers repetitive housing (mass housing developments with a single unit design repeated), not the general low-rise residential category. Group 4 covers residences such as single-detached, duplexes, rowhouses, small apartment houses, and townhouses. Low-rise residentials = Group 4 at 10% of PCC — distinct from repetitive housing (Group 7) and utilitarian structures (Group 1).
